description: This file defines the ISensorCentral interface, which specifies methods for sensor management, including initialization, value retrieval and setting, listener management, and obtaining value sources within the sensor system.

classes.name: ISensorCentral
classes.description: Interface for sensor management, providing methods for initializing sensors, getting and setting sensor values, managing listeners, and retrieving value sources.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the sensor central with a given engine state.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the current value from a specified sensor.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a specified value for a given sensor.

methods.name: setAnySensorListener
methods.description: Sets a listener that will be notified for any sensor updates.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Adds a listener for a specific sensor.

methods.name: removeListener
methods.description: Removes a listener for a specific sensor.

methods.name: getValueSource
methods.description: Retrieves the value source associated with a specific sensor.
